svg.title: Mouse · Cream
svg.desc: Compact cream laboratory mouse with warm pale beige fur, lighter belly, pink extremities, large pinnae, and a thin tail. Biological basis: Cream and pale beige phenotypes result from reduced or modified pigment expression and remain visually distinct from both dark-eyed white and albino coats.
